title: Mia's Good Morning
text:
Healthy habits make our bodies strong. Mia wakes up early every day. She eats eggs and bread for breakfast. She drinks a glass of milk too.

Mia thinks breakfast is important. After school, she walks to the park with her dog. She runs and plays for thirty minutes. The park is clean and green, and Mia feels happy with a lot of energy.

questions.text: What does Mia eat for breakfast?
How long does Mia run and play in the park?
Which word best describes Mia after her time in the park?

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
a public green place where people walk, play, or relax
the strength to do things and be active

paragraph_translations: Sağlıklı alışkanlıklar vücudumuzu güçlü yapar. Mia her gün erken uyanır. Kahvaltıda yumurta ve ekmek yer. Bir bardak süt de içer.
Mia kahvaltının önemli olduğunu düşünür. Okuldan sonra köpeğiyle parka yürür. Otuz dakika koşar ve oynar. Park temiz ve yeşildir; Mia mutlu hisseder ve çok enerjisi olur.
